purpose: Evidence for the three FILL questions that block Phase 5 wording. Only literal filesystem facts; unknowns stay unknown.

internal.note: A basename appearing in several class folders would be a labelling conflict; duplicates_within_split are reported separately below.

established: The internal set is 11148 2-D JPEG/PNG images in 4 class folders (Train + Test); no patient/subject identifiers exist in any filename.
4463 of 10223 unique internal basenames (43.7%) are also present in the local Kaggle zip, so the internal pool is substantially a re-use of that Kaggle release.

The remainder uses a distinct naming family {'kaggle_Tr_prefix': 3624, 'inst_code_X_###_XX_': 3439, 'plain_numeric': 1713, 'other': 1013, 'kaggle_Te_prefix': 839, 'gg_paren': 363, 'image_paren': 123, 'N_no': 34}, which is not BraTS (BraTS has no pituitary or no-tumour class).
not_established: Who produced the 4-class labels and from which primary source the non-Kaggle portion was collated - no download script, README, manifest or citation for this folder exists anywhere in the repository.
verdict.paper_wording: state the class counts and the image-level split; mark the label origin [CITATION NEEDED]; do not claim BraTS provenance.

established: The archive on disk is literally named 'brain-tumor-mri-dataset.zip' and holds 7023 entries with top-level dirs ['Testing', 'Training'] and per-directory counts {'Testing/glioma': 300, 'Testing/meningioma': 306, 'Testing/notumor': 405, 'Testing/pituitary': 300, 'Training/glioma': 1321, 'Training/meningioma': 1339, 'Training/notumor': 1595, 'Training/pituitary': 1457}.
Those counts equal the canonical Kaggle 'Brain Tumor MRI Dataset' release (Training 5712 + Testing 1311 = 7023).

The *extracted* folders used by the pipeline are an incomplete extraction of that zip: {'Training': {'glioma': 1321, 'meningioma': 1339, 'notumor': 1221}, 'Testing': {'glioma': 300, 'meningioma': 306, 'notumor': 405, 'pituitary': 300}}.
not_established: The Kaggle owner slug / URL is not written in the repo; only the archive file name is. Treat the exact link as [VERIFY] until confirmed against the Kaggle page.
verdict.paper_wording: cite the dataset by its archive name and canonical size; [VERIFY] the author/URL before camera-ready.

established: Classification is trained and evaluated only on 2-D JPEG/PNG slices (data/raw/classification); BraTS contributes no classification images.
The local BraTS copy holds 1000 NIfTI volumes and 200 segmentation targets; it is the segmentation-only source.
BraTS 2024 carries no pituitary and no healthy/no-tumour label, so it cannot supply the 4-class labels used by the classifier.
No 3-D->2-D slice conversion exists in the classification path; the 4-class task was never run on converted BraTS volumes.
not_established: Which BraTS 2024 task/subset the segmentation checkpoint was trained on, and the exact slice-selection rule, are only recorded as [VERIFY] in results/dataset_table.csv.
verdict.paper_wording: BraTS = segmentation evaluation only; WT/TC/ET Dice belong to the standalone 3-D U-Net (D3), not to TAMNet's classification path.
